description_expanded: Ocean 52 - WaterColor Florida Vacation Rentals Favorite Features: - 4 Included Bikes - Screened-In Porch - Custom-Built Bunk Room - Community Pool - Pets Allowed - Monthly Rates Available More about Ocean 52: Ocean 52 is a family-friendly beach cottage in the Camp District of WaterColor Florida where there is so much for families to see and do. WaterColor offers four community pools, a pay-per-play tennis center, bike trails, and access to beautiful Gulf of Mexico beaches. The Town Center of WaterColor features restaurants with indoor and al fresco dining options, mom-and-pop shops, and plenty of sidewalk and walkway space. Bicycles are a popular way to get around the area, and four are included with this WaterColor rental.   Each bedroom is spacious, fitted with a flat-screen TV, and attached to a private bathroom. First-floor king suite is ideal for anyone who prefers not to climb stairs. It has private access to the screened-in porch and a private bathroom with a dual sink vanity, a jetted tub, a standalone shower, and a private water closet. The second floor houses a king suite and a bunk room. The bunk room features two twin-over-full bunks and a twin day bed. The final sleeping arrangement in the home is the second-floor loft with a flat screen TV and queen sleeper sofa. This furnished loft also provides a separate space for children to watch movies or for any guest’s use.   Downstairs, the kitchen offers granite counters and a center island with barstool seating. It is also appointed with stainless steel appliances including a KitchenAid refrigerator with a freezer drawer, a dishwasher, oven, and 5-burner gas range. The cabinets are stocked with utensils and dinnerware, a starter pack of dish soap is provided, and there is even a coffee pot available to make your morning brew. Meals can be enjoyed in the dining area with a table to seat 8 guests. There is also a large living room with two sofas, three sofa chairs, a flat screen TV, and a DVD player. Plank flooring throughout and beachy decor completes the beach cottage atmosphere.   Guests of Ocean 52 are close to everything in WaterColor! After a great day at the beach, guests can use the home's outdoor shower to rinse off. For dinner consider The BoatHouse, just a short stroll away. Eateries and boutiques are close by for your enjoyment as well. The grocery store and post office at WaterColor Crossings is also just a half mile away. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 2: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: Twin Bed & 2 Full over Full Bunks & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Fast Facts - 5-minute bike ride to the beach - 4-minute bike ride to the BoatHouse near Cerulean Park - 3-minute bike ride to Publix - 2-minute walk to Camp WaterColor Restaurants Nearby  - The Wine Bar - WaterColor on 30A - Great Southern Cafe in Seaside - Bud & Alley's in Seaside - Amavida Coffee and Tea
